stem: On 1 October 2025, 250 businesses subscribed to Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, paid €12,500 of MRR in total. By 1 October 2026, businesses that had paid €1,000 of that MRR had cancelled, others had downgraded by €250 in total, and others had upgraded by €1,750 in total. New businesses added €3,000 of MRR. What is the 12-month gross revenue retention (GRR)? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
